title: Text menu: wire Style (Bold/Italic), Align, Tracking, and Scrollable items for selected text fields
description:
The Text menu in `MenuBar.tsx` is an empty stub (`{ name: 'Text' }` with no items). Flash 8's Text menu contains the most frequently used text-formatting shortcuts, particularly useful when the text tool is active or a text field is selected on stage.

## What needs to be done

### 1. Populate the Text menu in MenuBar.tsx
Add menu items matching Flash 8's Text menu:

- **Style > Bold** (Ctrl+Shift+B) — toggle bold on selected/active text field
- **Style > Italic** (Ctrl+Shift+I) — toggle italic
- **Style > Plain** — clear bold and italic
- **Align > Align Left** (Ctrl+Shift+L)
- **Align > Align Center** (Ctrl+Shift+E)
- **Align > Align Right** (Ctrl+Shift+R)
- **Align > Justify** (Ctrl+Shift+J)
- **Tracking > Increase / Decrease / Reset** — adjust letter spacing ±1 or ±2 px
- **Scrollable** — toggle the 'scrollable' property on dynamic/input text fields

### 2. Wire handlers from Shell.tsx
Add `onTextBold`, `onTextItalic`, `onTextAlign`, etc. props to `MenuBarProps` (matching the existing callback-per-action pattern). In `Shell.tsx`, implement handlers that:
- Locate the selected `TextDisplayObject` in the governing keyframe of the active layer.
- Apply the mutation (e.g. `{ bold: true }`) via `updateDisplayObject` and push to history.
- Update the EditBar's local state if text is currently being edited in-place on the stage.

### 3. Keyboard shortcut registration
Add the new shortcuts to `useKeyboardShortcuts.ts` (Ctrl+Shift+B/I/L/E/R/J) guarded by `activeTool === 'text' || selectedDisplayObject?.type === 'text'`.

### 4. Sync EditBar toolbar with menu state
The `EditBar.tsx` already has Bold/Italic toggle buttons. Ensure the menu items and EditBar buttons share the same underlying handler so toggling one reflects in the other.

## Files likely touched
- `packages/authoring-ui/src/MenuBar.tsx`
- `packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx`
- `packages/authoring-ui/src/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts`
- `packages/authoring-ui/src/EditBar.tsx` (shared handler wiring)

## Acceptance criteria
- With a text field selected, Ctrl+Shift+B toggles bold and the stage re-renders the text accordingly.
- Ctrl+Shift+L/E/R/J changes alignment and the rendered text updates.
- The Text menu items have visible check-marks for the current state (bold checked when the selected text is bold, etc.).
